Question ID: ANP_U01_L04_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.ORG.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Body Organization and Homeostasis
Stimulus: Homeostasis feedback model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, start at cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism. Then use the required stimulus (Homeostasis feedback model) to connect the visible evidence to levels of organization and homeostasis feedback. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.ORG.01 and avoids the common mistake: thinking feedback loops make a value stay perfectly constant.
